G-grouse-atv-0079.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
G-grouse-atv-0079.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Halcyon Ridge Road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Road: Halcyon Ridge Road, 7.3 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.

flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 4 table (pages 39 and 40), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Pages 36 to 41 print no LEH list.

plan: Drive: from Salmon Arm, about 133 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.48576, -117.87855, where the truck road ends (Halcyon Ridge Road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: the Halcyon Ridge Road stretch, 7.3 km one way. About 146 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-31, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-25, closures 2026-10-03.
